## Problem and result

Link issue/research question. What changed and why?

## Evidence

Exact commit/spec, commands, versions, results and limitations:
Evidence class: SYNTHETIC_ONLY / SIMULATOR / PHYSICAL_DEVICE / NOT_MEASURED

## Review checklist

- [ ] Compatibility: editorial / compatible clarification / breaking, explained
- [ ] Positive/negative cases and relevant local checks reported
- [ ] Receipt, authenticity, binding, policy and enforcement claims separated
- [ ] Synthetic/reviewed aggregate data only; no personal data, secrets or raw logs
- [ ] Contribution authority and third-party provenance/notices checked
- [ ] No implicit relicensing, CLA, patent promise or rights assignment
- [ ] No manufacturer adoption, standardisation or partnership inferred
- [ ] Independent reviewer/gates still missing explicitly listed
